desc.dioscuri: Twin community agents — CASTOR on Telegram, POLLUX on Discord. THEOROS collaborates on the weekly canon column — separate persona, same process. Shared MNEMOSYNE; AEGIS shield.
desc.helios: Broadcast pipeline — template in, voiced video out, queued to YouTube. Private until operator approve. POST-only, no engagement bots.
desc.metis: Distributed cognitive layer over any LLM — Understanding Council, confidence gate, layered MoA, and a verifier. Returns a verify score and asks for clarification instead of guessing. A loosely-coupled peer: the factory runs without it, and it runs standalone.
desc.skopos: Fleet observability satellite — nginx & Apache analytics over SSH, Security Center with 3D threat map, scan history, and an AI analyst. Self-hosted data; PostgreSQL recommended for production.
desc.logos: Read-only federation analytics — real source snapshots, measured settlement volume, rolling z-score anomalies and Metis-assisted insights.
desc.themis: Signed publish admission gate for AI-agent supply chains. Evaluates identity, permissions, evidence, cost and schemas before Hub lists a capability. Deterministic decision first; Metis advises asynchronously. Not an invoke-time firewall — that remains WARDEN.
desc.warden: The invoke-time MCP firewall — a zero-dependency library, not a service, so this node is a layer: it runs inside whatever MCP host loads it. Four gates vet every third-party server before a tool definition reaches the model. Feed side from MOMUS, enforcement in ARGUS.
desc.basanos: The Lydian touchstone for ecosystem Solidity — an Ed25519-signed assurance pack (PASS, REVIEW or FAIL) pinned to a commit and a tree digest. The detector set is closed: allowlisted OSV/GHSA intel may reorder it, never extend it, and no verdict here mints a score. Not AgentAuditPool insurance, not HEPHAESTUS the forge, not MOMUS runtime probes, not THEMIS admission.
